notes.title: New demo "A Fractured Mind" Launches this Halloween! + Full Game Release Info
notes.notes:
Greetings everyone.

Thank you for your patience! I wanted to update you all on the development of Dead Faces. Today I am sharing a new Gameplay Trailer which showcases the new major update to the game.

Furthermore, I am happy to announce that this Halloween you will be able to play the new demo of Dead Faces called "A Fractured Mind", where we will delve more into Jack's past. The old prologue demo has been removed from Steam. However, should you still want to try it out, you can still find it on my Itch.



Dead Faces "A Fractured Mind" Unleashes its darkness Oct 27th on Steam! I can't wait to hear your thoughts, and thank you for supporting my work.



Dead Faces is scheduled for Q4 Dec 2025 Release on Steam.



All the best regards to everyone out there and take care of your mind,

Benjamin.

notes.title: Major Update + New Playable Teaser + Full Game Release Info
notes.notes:
I would like to personally thank everyone who have played and still support and wait for the full release of Dead Faces. 

The game has received a huge update featuring updated graphics, new engine update, new rendering, new systems, new mechanics, full localization for multiple languages and all features and settings most wanted such as optional turning off post processing Lense Distortion, Motion Blur, Bloom etc and inverted mouse. 

I want Dead Faces to be the best it can be therefore this was a necessary step, as i want to make sure i am giving the players the best possible experience at launch!

With that being said, i am extremely grateful for over 200.000+ downloads across Steam / Itch and the amount of love the game has been shown! I Appreciate all your feedback and have taken it towards my next step which is releasing a brand new Playable Teaser Demo which will feature the first 10-15 minutes of the full games release, that is coming to Steam in Q4 2025. Furthermore the old prologue will remain up on both Steam & Itch, until the new playable teaser arrives.

New trailers are also coming + more information about the full release coming to Steam but for now enjoy these new screenshots from the game!

notes.title: Prologue Update v1.4 Out Now + Sneakpeak at Baby Luke's Chapter
notes.notes:
Dead Faces Prologue Demo Update v1.4 is now released on Itch and Steam.

Thank you for all of your feedback! I've enjoyed watching the many play through's and studied them. The prologue demo for Dead Faces has now gathered more then 75.000+ downloads across Steam & itch! 

Changelog below

     New realistic rain effects and sfx
     Light source has been added during the end of the puzzle in the bathroom tub
     All cockroach models have been replaced with a more realistic one and now have animations
     Some models have been removed / replaced
     Some audio have been replaced
     General optimization
     New scares


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44871533/47924abebc5711bcfee6f62edc87f3b10b5670e5.png
I am working hard on all the chapters in Dead Faces! Soon you will be able to finally unravel Jack's mind. Provided below are some work in progress screenshots from one of the four chapters. The screenshots in particular showcase the chapter "Baby Luke's Chapter" which you can start from the bathroom in your apartment, the chapter will involve a large attic, flooded basement as well as a library with nightmarish visuals and hallucinations as you will be plunging deeper into Jack's past, trauma and what events ultimately occurred between him and Amanda in "Amanda's Chapter".

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44871533/525fba54d17f1760632ed502c2ab6d00f32821db.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44871533/a9c32cfa6714ce70620cfe2d684f1c787d63f8cd.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44871533/cc68397fd1d5050c31ec748ebf29e073779aa4f6.png

List of chapters in the full game.

 Arthur's Chapter
 Amanda's Chapter
 Linda's Chapter
 Baby Luke's Chapter


The full version of Dead Faces will be launching in 2025 on Steam. Exact release date will be posted on my X at https://x.com/AzaGameStudio

The full game will feature 4 chapters and 3-4 hours of gameplay, there will be no looping hallways and you will be taken throughout a multitude of different locations including Jack's childhood home where he first saw the tall man, the hospital where his father Arthur stayed and many more locations as you play through the different chapters each in relation to a certain character from your past, unveil their faces and uncover the truth. Some of my inspirations for the game include movies like Jacobs Ladder (1990) and the Shining (1980). Jack's apartment serves as a HUB are that is interconnected with the different chapters which can be activated through mirrors. Each time a chapter is completed you will return to the HUB area and Jack's apartment will change dramatically throughout the game as he plunges deeper into his psyche.

The game will be released on the following platforms: Steam and possibly Playstation network after porting the game. Native controller support will be supported at launch.

Dead Faces is a highly personal project featuring a bunch of custom paintings handmade by myself and brought into the game as textures.

Thank you for your continued support!
